summary: Huntington Bancshares filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce its board declared quarterly cash dividends on common and six series of preferred stock. The common dividend is $0.155 per share, unchanged from the prior quarter, payable July 1, 2026 to holders of record June 17, 2026. Preferred dividends are payable July 15, 2026. No advisor is named, no structural or mechanical details beyond the declaration. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special-situation event; no deal terms or risk-arb angle are applicable.
